name: Foam FPS
desc:
PREMIUM BENIFITS: 1.5X Cash and XP boost in-game! 

Foam FPS is a foam flinging first person shooter where you tag your friends and foes in an ultimate foam flinging experience! You'll be able to customize between 40+ different guns and play on multiple maps and game modes! 

Version 6.21
8/12/2024 changelog:
- Brought back character customizer
- Store now has a PolicyService check, this means the game will be playable in stricter countries
- Optimized bullet lag and trails
- Fixed mobile jump button
- Re-added FFA and Gun Game score UI
- Adjusted blue v orange score UI 

I'm working at another roblox game studio, I was dev on the Jaws: Infested Waters experience, so this is still a side thing that I'm not going to update for very much longer.
